posts.headline: The press that wins the ball in 5 seconds

outro.question: Which side would you spring the trap on, left or right?

lines.text: The press that wins the ball in five seconds.
Team A set up in a four-three-three. Three up top, three in midfield, and a flat back four.
Watch the centre-back. The second he plays it wide to the full-back, that's the trigger.
Now they squeeze. Every short pass is cut off, and the touchline does the rest.
Ball won! Two quick passes, the striker's through, and it's in the back of the net.

posts.headline: Why teams crowd one side on purpose

outro.question: Which winger would you want in that one-v-one?

lines.text: Why top teams crowd one side on purpose.
Flood the left. Full-back, winger, midfielders, even the striker drifts across.
The defence has to slide with them, and one man is left alone on the far side.
Then switch it. One long diagonal to the isolated winger.
One against one, with space to attack. Cut inside, and finish.
